title: Glass Jar Straight-Sided – 3 Sizes
description:
Crystal clear storage for dry or liquid products.

Features:
– Jars withstand extreme temperatures of -15° to 500°C (0° to 930°F).
– Wide mouth for easy pouring and filling.
– Caps included. Metal lids for food storage.
– FDA compliant.

LIDS:
– Material: Electrolytic tin coated steel
Liner- Plastisol
– Liner is FDA compliant.
– Max Temperature: 102 C (215 F)

FEATURES:
– Leakproof and airtight.

SPECIFICATIONS:
– Lid: BPA Free
